headline_marked: Steam's [[Achievement Sets]] now live to stop DLCs ruining 100 percent records
headline: Steam's Achievement Sets now live to stop DLCs ruining 100 percent records
summary: New feature separates base game and DLC achievements, preventing future content from impacting your completion percentage.
details: Steam has rolled out a new feature called Achievement Sets, now available in the Steam Client beta. This update aims to prevent downloadable content (DLC) from negatively affecting a player's overall game completion percentage.

Developers will need to update their games to implement these sets, which can be organized by purpose, such as separating single-player and multiplayer achievements or creating seasonal event sets. The platform reports that a growing number of games already support this functionality.

The new Achievement Sets will be visible on a player's profile, with each set displaying its own progress bar. Completing an entire set will award a 'set complete' trophy, and progress on base game achievements will remain at 100 percent even if new achievements are added later.

To avoid impacting overall game progress, DLC achievements and their progress bars are displayed separately in purple, distinct from the blue progress bars for base game achievements. These DLC sets will only appear in your progress once you own the relevant DLCs.

The achievements page has also been redesigned to better showcase these sets and your progress. Additionally, it now allows you to compare your achievement status, including rare trophies and completed sets, with up to three friends.
